ei.title: Lectins Eaten by Us Can Cause Health Problems in Our Bodies
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Lectins Eaten by Us Can Cause Health Problems in Our Bodies

fullPassage: Lectins are large proteins that serve as a crucial weapon that plants use to defend themselves. The lectins in most plants bind to carbohydrates as we consume the plant. They also bind to sugar molecules found in the gut, in the brain, between nerve endings, in joints and in all bodily fluids. According to Dr. Steven Gundry, these sticky proteins can interrupt messaging between cells and cause toxic and inflammatory reactions. Brain fog is just one result of lectins interrupting communication between nerves. An upset stomach is another common symptom of lectin overload. Dr. Gundry lists a wide range of other health problems including aching joints, dementia, headaches and infertility that have been resolved in his patients once they eliminated lectins from their diets. Dr. Paul Saladino writes that the hypothesis that lectins are involved in Parkinson's disease is also gaining support, with animal studies showing that 'lectins, once eaten, may be damaging the gut and travelling to the brain, where they appear to be toxic to dopaminergic neurons'.

④ sugar molecules(설탕 분자): 렉틴이 결합하는 대상이지 증상의 원인 아님
det.tip: lectin overload = 렉틴 과다. 위장 장애의 원인

questions.passage: Lectins are large proteins that serve as a crucial weapon that plants use to defend themselves. The lectins in most plants bind to carbohydrates as we consume the plant. They also bind to sugar molecules found in the gut, in the brain, between nerve endings, in joints and in all bodily fluids. According to Dr. Steven Gundry, these sticky proteins can interrupt messaging between cells and cause toxic and inflammatory reactions. Brain fog is just one result of lectins interrupting communication between nerves. An upset stomach is another common symptom of lectin overload. Dr. Gundry lists a wide range of other health problems including aching joints, dementia, headaches and infertility that have been resolved in his patients once they eliminated lectins from their diets. Dr. Paul Saladino writes that the hypothesis that lectins are involved in Parkinson's disease is also gaining support, with animal studies showing that 'lectins, once eaten, may be damaging the gut and travelling to the brain, where they appear to be toxic to __________'.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

① sugar molecules(설탕 분자): 렉틴이 결합하는 대상이지 뇌에서 독성 대상 아님
② dopaminergic neurons: 렉틴이 뇌로 이동하여 '도파민 신경세포'에 독성을 보인다 — 문맥 일치 ←정답
③ inflammatory reactions(염증 반응): 결과이지 독성 대상 아님
④ bodily fluids(체액): 렉틴이 발견되는 장소이지 독성 대상 아님
det.tip: dopaminergic neurons = 도파민 신경세포. 파킨슨병과 연관
